chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Khashshab from Ali ibn Asbat, from one who narrated in al-Jalalat:
There is no harm in eating them if they are mixed.

key_terms.الْجَلَّالَاتِ: Animals fed on dung or excrement

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat animals fed on dung according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Isfahani's chain in al-Istibsar clarifies the ruling on 'Jalalat' (animals fed on excrement) by introducing the concept of mixing or blending, which mitigates their impure status. It reflects the Shia scholarly approach to reconciling apparent contradictions in hadith regarding the consumption of such animals, emphasizing practical leniency when they are not consumed exclusively or in isolation.
